negative_reviews.author: Ian Wood
negative_reviews.text: Service was very good. Food was nice, but very expensive for what it was. £15 yakisoba tofu dish had just three small slices of tofu and one piece of tender stem broccoli. The banging of the drum every time a customer group was seated became a bit annoying.

negative_reviews.author: Local reviewer.
negative_reviews.text: The service was ok the atmosphere was good. The food came served warm and not hot as we wanted it. Overall experience was mediocre sadly..

negative_reviews.author: Ma haluen
negative_reviews.text:
Food is average, much better sushi and ramen in other places in Chinatown.

Sushi tasted like it was made hours in advance. I expect most of the food here probably is.

negative_reviews.author: Bear Claw
negative_reviews.text: Adding this review due to very poor customer service, didn’t even get through the front door. Was booked for 8pm at the weekend. Arrived early, 7.30pm. Was told I am too early and I will have to wait outside!  Or to go away and come back. Taking into account it was very cold on the evening in question. I asked,  can I not wait at a bar area. Was told they don’t really have a bar. 2 other people then arrived, exactly 2 minutes later. They were led straight in. From seeing this I promptly left and went to another establishment where I was welcomed with no issue. PS. Didn’t have a booking with them, told me not to wait in the cold and seated me while they prepared a table. Now this is the service I expect. Not to be treated like an inconvenience.
